digtinfo.formspec: The SHP file contains the geospatial data. The SHX file contains the index of the geospatial data. The DBF file contains the attribute data in dBASE® format. The PRJ file contains the coordinate system information (optional). The AVL file contains the legend information (optional). The SBN and SBX files contain the spatial index of the geospatial data (optional). The XML file (*.shp.xml) contains the metadata describing the data set (optional).

procstep.procdesc: The following steps were performed by ESRI: Extracted Eur_c.shp from AND Global Road Data. Removed unneeded attributes. Added the TYPE attribute and coded it with the type descriptions. Recoded the TYPE attribute for some features based on comparisons with Europe Cities. Added CNTRYNAME attribute and coded it based on the values of the NATION attribute. Merged multiple record features into single record features. Rearranged and renamed attributes. Created ArcView legend file (.avl), ArcGIS™ layer file (.lyr), projection file (.prj), and spatial indices.
